title: VIXEN kernel-codegen cache snapshot omitted the analyzer project for a tracked lane pin
body: The queued WSL Release build configured against the old cached kernel snapshot 4b5605bdd and failed at SourceGenerator~/SDFNodeGenerator.csproj:117 with MSB1009 because the cache snapshot path had no SDFNodeGenerator.csproj. Recovery requires repinning and reconfiguring so the cache materializes the complete kernel source tree; the facade should validate snapshot completeness before invoking AnalyzerStamp.

title: VIXEN kernel snapshots must include the AnalyzerStamp project used by Release source-generator builds
body: The VIXEN kernel snapshot manifest omitted tools/AnalyzerStamp even though SourceGenerator~/SDFNodeGenerator.csproj invokes it during every Release codegen build. The integrated build failed MSB1009 until the allowlist was extended. The facade should derive or validate the complete analyzer-deployment project closure for each pinned snapshot.

title: VIXEN split-test preflight passed a fixed parallel width into the live queue
body: The WSL Release witness stopped before CTest because tools/run-tests-split.sh invoked queued cmake --build with --parallel 22 and the live queue correctly refused the R881/R882 width override. The harness now uses UT_QUEUE_GRANTED_CPUS inside queued build and CTest payloads; the facade should make queue-grant width propagation automatic and reject fixed widths at authoring time.

title: VIXEN split-test resolver omitted selected executable build edges
body: The queued WSL Release preflight built its resolved target list successfully, but final validation still found CTest-selected test_run_data_paths and test_spirv_descriptor_layout as NOT_BUILT because the resolver metadata omitted those executable edges. The witness required a manual queued cmake --build of the two exact targets before rerun; the facade should derive every selected executable target or fail at selection resolution with the located omission.

title: VIXEN split-test harness forwarded PROCESSORS as a forbidden queue token override
body: The final WSL witness selected a GPU suite with PROCESSORS=4; tools/run-tests-split.sh translated that declaration into --cpu-tokens on every GPU shard, and the live queue refused all shards under R881/R882 before CTest. The harness now leaves CPU width and PROCESSORS admission to the queue/CTest payload; the facade should carry resource requirements declaratively instead of passing lane-level token overrides.

title: VIXEN WSL witness mode enabled a missing GPU witness layer
body: The queued WSL split witness set VIXEN_GPU_WITNESS_DIR to build/wsl/gpu-witness-layer, but only VkLayer_vixen_gpu_witness.json was present and libVkLayer_vixen_gpu_witness.so was absent, so BodyOctreeLifetimeTest failed during harness setup. The facade/tooling should build or validate the witness layer before enabling witness mode; workaround is to run the same CTest scope without witness or provision the shared library.

title: VIXEN split-test resolver emitted disabled-only GPU shards
body: The WSL GPU split resolver assigned Application.LookdevCapture.Presentation.night-service (a CTest-disabled case) as the sole entry in shard 1. The queued CTest command used --no-tests=error, so it returned exit 8 with no product test executed. The facade should filter disabled tests before shard assignment or make empty/disabled-only shards successful without weakening real no-tests validation.

title: VIXEN native Release checkout required manual Ninja pin provisioning
body: The queued native Windows Release route reached a fresh lane checkout with the pinned Ninja 1.13.1 missing, so build.bat provision had to download and install the tool into VIXEN/.win-native-toolchain before the build could configure. The facade/toolchain snapshot should provision or validate the complete native pin set before the witness build is admitted.

title: VIXEN native Python-line gate selected WSL bash with native paths
body: The queued Windows Release build compiled and linked all product targets but python_lines_check.stamp failed because CMake selected C:/Users/liory/AppData/Local/Microsoft/WindowsApps/bash.exe and invoked it with C:/vixen-native/vx10/VIXEN/tools/check-python-lines.sh; WSL bash reported the path did not exist. The workaround is to prefer installed Git Bash for native source-only gates, then reconfigure and rebuild. The facade should select a path-compatible shell automatically.

title: Native CPU CTest wrapper defaults to Debug build tree
body: The queued native Release witness passed the supported run-native-cpu-suite.bat through tools/vixen-native.sh, but the wrapper defaulted VIXEN_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR to build/ninja and failed before CTest because the admitted Release build is build/ninja-release. Recovery required manually setting VIXEN_NATIVE_BUILD_DIR to the configured Release tree. Tier haiku: the wrapper should derive or validate the requested configuration and fail early with the located mismatch.

title: Native GPU suite wrapper falls through to the look-dev selector
body: The queued native GPU witness invoked tools/run-native-gpu-suite.bat without arguments, but the batch file fell through from its general CTest argument branch into the lookdev-hud label because it lacked a jump to the phase runner. Recovery required adding the missing goto so the no-argument route executes the full GPU list and the explicit selector remains narrow. Tier haiku: one control-flow edge and a wrapper test can make the two scopes unambiguous.

title: Native editor AppFlow fixture dropped the resolved .NET launcher
body: The queued native GPU suite reached vixen_editor_capture_producer, but the Python AppFlow adapter failed with WinError 2 while spawning bare dotnet. Native CMake had already resolved VIXEN_DOTNET=C:/Program Files/dotnet/dotnet.exe, but run_editor_capture.cmake did not export it as YEROKET_DOTNET. Recovery wires the resolved launcher into the generated fixture script. Tier luna because the native CMake/Python boundary needs one shared launcher contract and a focused witness.
